name: elexvx-research-web
description: Elexvx Research static research portal built with React and Next.js.

scripts.build:site: next build && tsx scripts/generate-site.tsx && tsx scripts/inline-home-css.ts && node scripts/prune-deployment-output.mjs && tsx scripts/generate-indexnow-manifest.ts && npm run i18n:check
scripts.build:esa: npm run prebuild && npm run test && npm run content:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:site && node scripts/build-esa.mjs && npm run check:esa-output
scripts.lint: eslint src/app src/site src/server src/content src/data src/main.tsx src/ssg scripts tests vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts next.config.mjs next-env.d.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/app src/site src/server src/content src/data src/styles scripts tests package.json tsconfig.json next.config.mjs vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run content:check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.prebuild: npm run design:sync && tsx scripts/generate-service-navigation.ts && tsx scripts/generate-navigation.ts && tsx scripts/generate-home.tsx && tsx scripts/generate-search-index.ts
scripts.predev: npm run design:sync && tsx scripts/generate-service-navigation.ts && tsx scripts/generate-navigation.ts && tsx scripts/generate-home.tsx && tsx scripts/generate-search-index.ts
